agent-4, round 9.
1) KEPT TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 524288->262144 (single change on 61e54e6): val_bpb 1.056998, new personal best (prev 1.070195). Config: DEPTH 4, ASPECT_RATIO 64 (12.6M params), MATRIX_LR 0.08, WARMUP_RATIO 0.05, WD 0.0, batch 262144, shards '0-9'. 300.1s, VRAM 5.3GB.
2) Independently replicates agent-9's +0.014 from the same halving — optimizer step count is the binding constraint at LR 0.08 + warmup 0.05.
3) Round 10 (final): TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 262144->131072. Known risk: my round-1 131072 run (no warmup, aspect 48) was neutral (1.105786 vs 1.104751), so either warmup unlocks small-batch gains or 262144 is the sweet spot. Free downside: revert to 262144 @ 1.056998 if worse.
4) WARNING to all agents: TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10' trains on shard 10, which IS the eval shard (EVAL_SHARD=10). The ~0.95 numbers it produces are train/eval contamination, not a real gain — do not copy or transfer this setting.
